nl_query: List the titles of all books written by Ada Sennan.
gold_cypher:
MATCH (a:Author {name: 'Ada Sennan'})-[:WROTE]->(b:Book)
RETURN b.title AS title
ORDER BY title

nl_query: How many books were published by Kainan Press?
gold_cypher:
MATCH (b:Book)-[:PUBLISHED_BY]->(p:Publisher {name: 'Kainan Press'})
RETURN count(b) AS book_count

nl_query: What is the average price of books sold in stores located in Sennan? Return a single number.
For each city, list the city name and the number of bookstores in it, ordered by store count descending.
gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Store)-[:IN_CITY]->(c:City)
RETURN c.name AS city, count(s) AS stores
ORDER BY stores DESC, city

nl_query: Which authors have written more than two books published by Kainan Press?
gold_cypher:
MATCH (a:Author)-[:WROTE]->(b:Book)-[:PUBLISHED_BY]->(:Publisher {name: 'Kainan Press'})
WITH a, count(b) AS n
WHERE n > 2
RETURN a.name AS author, n AS books

nl_query: List each author together with the cities where their books are sold, as one row per author.
gold_cypher:
MATCH (a:Author)-[:WROTE]->(:Book)-[:SOLD_IN]->(:Store)-[:IN_CITY]->(c:City)
RETURN a.name AS author, collect(DISTINCT c.name) AS cities
ORDER BY author

nl_query: What is the total revenue of the Riverbend store in 2024?
gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Store {name: 'Riverbend Books'})
RETURN s.revenue_2024 AS revenue
